'''Moz''', designated '''CT-6200/8901''', was a [[Covert Ops clone trooper]] trained by [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null ARC]] [[Jaing Skirata|N-10]].

During a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaftikar]] to eliminate [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Sull]], who deserted from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], Moz and [[Olun]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] of [[Omega Squad]], who they mistook for Sull.

Overcome by the guilt of killing one of his own brothers, Darman spoke their names everyday, the Mandalorian style to keep their memories alive.
